questions.question: How does Psalm 97 begin?
options: How long, O LORD, will you forget me?
O God, why have you cast us off forever?
A bitter cry rises up from the land
The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice
questions.answer: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice

questions.question: What surrounds the LORD in this psalm?
options: Fire and rolling thunder, and wrath and terror are his fearsome weapons
Light and shining glory, and mercy and grace are the crown upon his head
Wind and a gentle stillness, and peace and quiet are his place of rest
Clouds and thick darkness; righteousness and justice are his foundation
questions.answer: Clouds and thick darkness; righteousness and justice are his foundation

questions.question: The psalm urges those who love the LORD to hate evil.
The LORD _____, let the earth rejoice; let the many coastlands be glad!
Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright in _____.
